limitations: Research prototype; not medical advice and not for clinical decision-making.

The model learns glucose change at 30/60/90/120 minutes and the curve between those knots is linearly interpolated, so the reported peak time is resolved only to those knots and true peak timing may fall between them.
Prediction intervals are not calibrated, so no interval bounds are reported.
Drivers are reported at the 60-minute horizon, where this forecast peaks, and describe that horizon only.
Produced by a model trained on synthetic development fixtures, not on organizer data. No external validity is claimed.
